wording: Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform under this agreement due to events beyond its reasonable control (war, natural disaster, government action, port closures, shipping blockade). Performing party must: (a) suspension of performance is required, not termination; (b) notify other party within 48 hours; (c) resume performance within 30 days; (d) if suspension exceeds 90 days, either party may terminate without penalty. Force majeure does not include labour strikes, supplier's financial failure, or shipping delays.
